aggregation: Each policy/condition averages paired episodes; independent unit is training seed. SD is sample SD across available seed means; n=1 yields null SD.
evaluation_scope: Seeds 3042/4042 were not used for training but their results were observed in the prior DR study; this is a fixed-scenario comparability re-evaluation, not a new blind test set.
configuration_selection: Dyna configuration is selected using training-internal held-out diagnostics and smoke checks, then frozen before formal evaluation; no tuning based on formal results.

world_model_diagnostics.note: 各训练种子分别展示；无想象候选/优化器更新时，对应通过率/损失的零占位不绘制。模型训练损失不等于泛化性能。

limitations: Local Dyna-style implementation, not a paper-specific reproduction.
Dyna and full_dr share training physics and real interaction budgets; Dyna adds model and imagined optimization compute, so this is not compute-matched.
Learned history model is approximate; nonterminal one-step model with no learned termination, discarded terminal transitions and uncertainty gating introduce selection and model bias.
Only three independent training seeds; do not interpret evaluation episodes as independent training replicates.
Common evaluation scenarios already observed in prior DR work; no tuning or checkpoint selection against this formal evaluation.
Local reference simulator and in-range randomization only; no official or hardware claims.

paragraphs: **本轮主要指标未优于完整域随机化 PPO。** 随机物理条件下，Dyna-PPO 的瞬时前向速度 RMSE 为 0.042265 ± 0.005728 m/s，完整 DR 为 0.037475 ± 0.001722 m/s；Dyna 均值升高 12.78%（误差越低越好）。

随机条件逐种子比较：种子 42 近乎持平（差值 -0.000018 m/s）；种子 43 更差（差值 +0.007898 m/s）；种子 44 更差（差值 +0.006489 m/s）。标称条件均值接近：0.061727 ± 0.011355 对 0.062173 ± 0.003002 m/s（相对差 -0.72%）。“接近/持平”仅描述数值，不代表通过等效性检验；这些小样本结果不构成统计显著性结论。
相对原固定参数基线，随机条件 RMSE 下降约 39.13%。Dyna 方案本身保留了域随机化，因此这项差异不能全部归功于 Dyna；额外想象更新的作用应与完整 DR 对照比较。
随机条件的平滑性诊断：目标角速度 RMS均值下降 5.24%（2/3 个种子降低）；目标角加速度 RMS均值下降 15.20%（2/3 个种子降低）；实际关节角加速度 RMS均值下降 4.73%（1/3 个种子降低）。部分均值下降，但改善并非跨种子一致。原始动作裁剪比例从 43.92% 升至 56.08%；这些辅助指标应与主跟踪误差一同解读。
随机条件下，Dyna 的末端绝对航向角为 28.45 ± 34.73°、绝对侧移为 0.0773 ± 0.0430 m，完整 DR 分别为 13.10 ± 7.68°、0.0354 ± 0.0107 m。 实际关节角加速度均值下降主要来自种子 44，该种子的末端绝对航向角为 68.54°；平滑指标的均值改善伴随任务跟踪和方向表现的取舍，不能仅概括为“更少抖动”。
